question: Can a target-free, network-adaptive rank-16 cross-unit residual covariance operator reduce the frozen J residual below 1e-8 without a selector or identity input?

closed_axes: four-channel local Gram plus pooled context

base.model: Frozen P2R0F2J four-channel transport-energy coherence observer
base.outer_scoring_model: The already frozen J model trained on the complete outer training complement
base.inner_stacking_firewall: Within each outer training complement, train exactly three fresh J models. Each N-training row is represented only by the J model whose inner validation fold contains that row; neither that row nor any outer-validation row trained that J model.
base.inner_fold_rule: blake2s32(inner_seed:mlp_id) modulo 3, inner_seed = 1753358438 XOR ((outer_fold+1)*0x9E3779B1) using the full nonnegative integer product
base.inner_j_training: Exact frozen J architecture, loss, six epochs, exposure schedule, optimizer, and fixed final checkpoint; statistics use only the corresponding inner training split.

architecture.name: network-adaptive rank-16 cross-unit residual covariance observer
architecture.local_features: J's 36 target-free raw20/sigma, four signed-message, four contribution-energy, and four coherence feature groups
architecture.layer_heads: For L2:L15, one 34-vector head emits 16 factor innovations, 16 log-eigenvalue contributions, one log diagonal, and one signed score
architecture.whitening: G=V^T V/1024+2^-10 I; U=V G^-1/2 from a symmetric 16x16 eigendecomposition with eigenvalues floored at 2^-10. The eigensystem is stop-gradient during training so repeated eigenvalues cannot create undefined eigenvector derivatives; gradients still pass from U to V through the right multiplication.
architecture.reported_output: Frozen J correction plus delta at every corrected layer

training.schedule: CosineAnnealingLR over every batch of all eight epochs
training.loss: Outer-fit-normalized L2:L15 MSE of frozen-J-plus-delta with fixed layer weights 0.5..1.5 plus equal final focus, plus 0.05 times the exact diagonal-plus-low-rank Gaussian score of the remaining residual using Woodbury and the matrix-determinant lemma, plus 1e-5 log-scale magnitude penalty
training.checkpoint: Fixed final epoch 8 in every fold; no early stopping or checkpoint selection

decision_gate.pass: All conditions pass, followed by a separately frozen native deployment verification and literal meter.
decision_gate.fail: Close this exact rank-16 observer measured; no retune, second checkpoint, meter, selector, or deployment.

cost.authority: Conservative frozen source-structure arithmetic; literal meter only after the strict accuracy gate passes
